meta.title: Help and getting-started guide
meta.description: Get started with Godet in 5 steps, install the app on phone, tablet and computer, and answers to common questions.

title: Getting started with Godet
intro: Everything you need to keep your fleet’s log from today: first steps, installing on each device and answers to common questions.

pdf.title: Getting-started guide as PDF
pdf.text: Print it for the workshop or send it to your team.

account.title: Create your garage
account.text: “Create my garage” on godet.app: your name, your email, then the company name, country and currency. The 15-day trial starts right away, no credit card needed.

machine.title: Add your machines
machine.text: “+ Machine”: a short code (PE-01), the type, make, model and the current hour meter. Two due dates are created automatically: service and the annual safety check. Already have a log in Excel? Import it in one go (menu → Excel).

dues.title: Set the due dates
dues.text: In the machine card → Due dates: service every 250 or 500 h, inspection every year… Godet works out the next date from each machine’s real usage and turns it orange, then red.

entry.title: Log the first job
entry.text: The “Entry” button in the machine card or in workshop mode: type, date, hour meter, costs, photos. Linked to a due date, the entry renews it automatically.

team.title: Invite your team
team.text: Settings → Team: one invitation link per person, with their role (admin, mechanic, operator). Then stick a QR label in each cab (menu → QR labels).

install.title: Install the app
install.intro: Godet installs straight from the website, no app store needed. An icon appears on your home screen and Godet opens full screen, like an app. Updates are automatic.

iphone.name: iPhone and iPad
steps: Open godet.app in Safari and sign in.
Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
Tap “Add”: the Godet icon appears on your home screen.

android.name: Android
steps: Open godet.app in Chrome and sign in.
Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
Confirm: the Godet icon appears with your apps.

computer.name: Computer
steps: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar (a screen with an arrow).
Godet opens in its own window and shows up in the Start menu or the Dock.

install.note: Firefox and other browsers work too: just bookmark godet.app.

hours.a: Machine card → “Hours”, or the “Hours” button in workshop mode. The meter can only go up. Tip: “Read from a photo” reads the figure for you; check it before saving.

workshop.a: The “Workshop mode” button shows the fleet as a list, without 3D: big buttons for an entry or a reading, even with gloves on. A scanned QR label opens the right machine directly.

offline.a: On a device you’ve used before, the garage opens even offline. Entries and readings are sent automatically when the network is back (badge “2 entries waiting”).

remove.a: An entry can be edited or withdrawn with a reason. Once withdrawn it stays visible, struck through: that’s what makes the log count during an inspection.

costs.a: Machine card → Costs: parts, labour and downtime over 12 months, month by month. The card’s overview also shows the cost per operating hour.

print.a: Machine card menu → “Print the log”: the full log as a PDF, for an inspection, an appraisal or a sale.

reminders.a: Settings → Reminders: an email in the morning or a summary on Monday, only when there’s something to do.

assistant.a: The “Assistant” button at the top of the garage: “Which services are overdue?”, “How much did CH-02 cost this year?”, “How do I invite a mechanic?”.

gps.a: Switch on entry location (Settings → Company). The machine card then shows the last known location, with a link to the map.

archive.a: Machine card menu → “Archive machine”: it leaves the showroom, its log stays viewable and printable (Settings → Archived machines).

billing.a: Settings → Subscription: choose the plan by number of machines (from CHF 29 a month). Without a subscription the garage becomes read-only: nothing is deleted.

contact.title: Need help?
contact.text: First ask the garage assistant: it knows Godet and your fleet. Otherwise <contact>write to us</contact>; an idea for an improvement? That’s what the <ideas>ideas box</ideas> is for.
